answer.justification: Only logit-level measurements are available. KL 0.032 and TV 0.043 are the smallest of any category: slightly below the quantized range (0.039-0.071 KL, 0.048-0.055 TV) and well below fine-tuned (KL 0.081+) and system-prompted (KL 0.197+). Top-1 agreement 0.943 and Token-DiFR gap 0.044 sit near the quantized range (0.945-0.955; 0.03-0.04). Raw-score shift÷TV of 2.6 is close to quantized (2.2-2.3) and below the usual fine-tuned and system-prompted ranges, though the lower end of the fine-tuned range (3.1) is not far off. Base is ruled out because every value is non-zero. Fine-tuned is the closest alternative, because sequence agreement 0.625 and top-1 0.943 overlap its range, but the low KL and TV argue against it.
